action: Probe quantity packaging multiple constraint enforcement
expected_observation: Determine how non-multiple quantities are handled by Lion frontend/backend
actual_observation: Entering quantities not conforming to the site's default packaging increment triggers SweetAlert2 error modal containing keywords 'ضریب' / 'مضرب'. The site requires quantities conforming to the default packaging step.
notes: Raw vendor input exposes default step in #quantity-cell. Purchasing step rounding algorithms belong strictly to Phase 6 Vendor Adapter Specification.
